record: US EPA final technical support document, Mountaineer plant
facts: The original chimney height was 1,100 feet (335.28 m). Its replacement was commissioned in 2007 and is 1,000 feet (304.8 m) high.

record: EPA Ohio River Basin Energy Study, Mountaineer station case
facts: The plant was designed with a 500-foot (152.4 m) natural-draft cooling tower.

record: United States Department of Energy DOE/EIS-0445D, Section 2.3.3.1
facts: The existing Mountaineer power plant includes a single pulverized-coal generating unit, a hyperbolic cooling tower and ancillary facilities.
